summary: Creates points on the surface of input triangles/quads or inside a closed input volume. It can create point primitives, interpolate selected input attributes, and use hardware ray tracing for volume point generation when supported.

key_params.name: createpointprim
key_params.note: Create point primitives for generated points

key_params.name: method
key_params.note: Per primitive, volume, or deterministic/non-deterministic volume generation

key_params.name: numpoints
key_params.note: Approximate or maximum number of generated points

key_params.name: raydirmode
key_params.note: Constant or random ray direction for inside/outside tests

key_concepts: Sprinkle POP creates new points either on input primitive surfaces or inside an input volume.
Per Primitive mode distributes points approximately per primitive rather than per surface area, so large and small primitives can receive similar point counts.
Volume methods sample inside closed triangle/quad volumes; open meshes produce approximate or unreliable inside/outside results.
Number of Points is an approximate upper limit for volume methods, and Attempts per Point controls how hard the sampler tries to find valid interior points.
Create Point Primitives is useful for direct point rendering but can be disabled when the result is only a point list for copy, simulation, or attribute processing.
Point, primitive, and vertex attribute scopes decide which source attributes are interpolated or sampled onto the generated points.
common_gotchas: Per-primitive distribution is not constant per surface area; it is approximately constant per primitive.
Volume methods expect closed volumes; open meshes produce approximate or unreliable inside tests.
Turn off Create Point Primitives when the result is a source for copying or simulation rather than direct point rendering.
